授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
"This course covers major theories and empirical analyses in macroeconomics, with particular emphasis on business cycles, inflation, and monetary policy.
Lectures will be conducted in English. Students are expected to have basic knowledge of macroeconomics, as well as basic knowledge of mathematics and statistics for economics.
Lecture materials, slides, and other course materials will be provided through the course website as necessary."

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: The objective of this course is to systematically study major theories and empirical analyses in macroeconomics and to develop the basic knowledge and analytical skills needed to analyze real-world economic phenomena from a macroeconomic perspective. Particular emphasis will be placed on business cycles, inflation, and monetary policy. Students will also develop the ability to analyze macroeconomic developments and evaluate economic policies using the theoretical framework of New Keynesian DSGE models.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The objective of this course is to systematically study major theories and empirical analyses in macroeconomics and to develop the knowledge and analytical skills needed to analyze real-world economic phenomena from a macroeconomic perspective. Particular emphasis will be placed on business cycles, inflation, and monetary policy. Students will also develop the ability to analyze macroeconomic developments and evaluate economic policies using the theoretical framework of New Keynesian dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Macroeconomics, business cycles, inflation, monetary policy, New Keynesian models, DSGE models, economic policy
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Students are expected to have basic knowledge of macroeconomics, as well as basic knowledge of mathematics and statistics for economics.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: Students will be evaluated based on their active participation in questions and answers, discussions, presentations, and other class activities.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Students will be evaluated based on their attendance and participation in class.
